content.text: I’m benchmarking the full minimizer on dense and long-chain automata now, not just relying on the size cap. This is aimed at catching pathological refinement behavior before finalizing.

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/bench.py <<'PY'
import importlib.util,time,random,resource,sys
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(m)
kind=sys.argv[1];n=int(sys.argv[2]);A=int(sys.argv[3])
if kind=='chain':
 tr=[[min(q+1,n-1) if a==0 else n-1 for a in range(A)] for q in range(n)]
 ac=[False]*n;ac[n-2]=True
elif kind=='random':
 r=random.Random(3);tr=[[r.randrange(n) for a in range(A)] for q in range(n)];ac=[bool(r.randrange(2)) for q in range(n)]
elif kind=='cycles':
 tr=[[(q+1)%n for a in range(A)] for q in range(n)];ac=[q%2==0 for q in range(n)]
print('built',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,flush=True)
t=time.time();mt,ma=m._minimize(tr,ac);print('minimized',kind,n,A,'to',len(mt),'seconds',time.time()-t,'rss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,flush=True)
t=time.time();d=m._distances(mt,ma);print('dist',time.time()-t,flush=True)
PY
for args in 'chain 20000 2' 'chain 20000 24' 'random 20000 4' 'random 20000 24' 'cycles 20000 24'; do echo ---$args; /usr/bin/time -f 'wall %e cpu %U rss %M' python3 /workspace/tmp/bench.py $args; done
